subject: Primary-source reconciliation of SBIC East/Central/West, SBI Holdings, Ripple, Coinbase, Circle, Permission Coin ASK and Evernorth capital categories

capture.note: Primary SEC filings, official corporate pages and issuer announcements were inspected during this run. Exact per-request retrieval timestamps and original HTTP wire bytes were not exposed by the retrieval interface. Filing dates and event dates are not substituted for retrieval timestamps.

limitations: Issuer-filed disclosure is primary for the company's reported contracts and accounting, but not independent assurance that every future facility draw or planned XRP acquisition occurred.
The prospectus contains historical and closing-date data; it is not a current holdings statement.

sbic_identity.conclusion: SBIC East, SBIC Central and SBIC West are three distinct Japanese regional investment-development companies. They are not SBI Holdings and are not subsidiaries or aliases of SBI Holdings.
sbic_identity.legal_basis: Regional Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation companies operating under Japan's Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Companies Act (1963, Law No. 101).

sbic_identity.relation: The three regional SBIC companies identify one another as sister companies. Their names and legal profiles are distinct from SBI Holdings Inc.

chatgpt_disambiguation.official_event: SBIC East listed a June 12–13, 2025 manufacturing-focused generative-AI and machine-learning training course that included ChatGPT usage in its curriculum.
chatgpt_disambiguation.provider: The listing names a VOST instructor, not OpenAI.
chatgpt_disambiguation.conclusion: This is a training course, not evidence of an OpenAI partnership, ChatGPT product named SBIC, SBI Holdings relationship or ChatGPT integration.

sbic_identity.acronym_collision: SBIC also appears in AI literature as Social Bias Inference Corpus. That academic dataset is unrelated to the three Japanese regional companies.

ask_coin.conclusion: The strongest current ASK Coin candidate is Permission Coin ASK on Base and Polygon. The official contract list does not identify an XRPL deployment. This does not prove that every unrelated use of the phrase ASK Coin refers to Permission Coin.

evernorth_capital_reconciliation.derived_comparisons_note: The average purchase cost is a simple aggregate ratio of disclosed cash used and XRP purchased; it is not a lot-level execution VWAP. The closing-price comparison is historical and not a current valuation. The signed closing-price comparison is (closing price / average cash purchase cost - 1) * 100; a negative value means the closing price was below the historical average cash purchase cost.

in_kind_component_detail.note: The detailed subscription/contribution disclosures and the aggregate in-kind total are retained separately. Some detail categories are embedded in aggregate subscription totals; adding every displayed line item risks double counting.

debt_and_future_financing.intended_use: General corporate purposes, including XRP acquisition and other XRP-ecosystem activities.

debt_and_future_financing.repayment_due: Within five business days after the October 9, 2026 closing, or earlier after five business days' demand.

debt_and_future_financing.fee_timing: Within five business days after ELOC registration effectiveness; fully earned and non-refundable regardless of purchases.

ownership_and_governance.board_decision_rule: The four SBI Stockholders are controlled by SBI Holdings; voting and dispositive decisions are made by the SBI Holdings board by majority vote.
ownership_and_governance.note: 21.4% common equity and 39.9% voting power are different denominators. Do not report 39.9% as total economic ownership.

accounting_and_liquidity.xrp_accounting: Indefinite-lived intangible asset at cost less impairment; impairment uses the lowest observable intraday price on the principal market since acquisition of each XRP lot.
accounting_and_liquidity.fair_value_upward_revaluation: No upward mark-to-market gain under this cost-less-impairment treatment until disposition.
accounting_and_liquidity.company_disclosure: The holding company's assets consist substantially of XRP rather than cash. The prospectus warns that liquidity needs or debt obligations may require XRP sales.
accounting_and_liquidity.implication: Corporate XRP holdings are not equivalent to cash liquidity. Debt maturities, cash settlement options and operating costs can create future funding pressure, but do not prove a sale has occurred.

actual_capital_phrase.interpretation: The filing uses separate categories: gross cash proceeds at closing, private-placement cash, cash spent acquiring XRP, XRP contributed in kind, trust-account cash, convertible debt, related-party borrowing, contingent equity-facility proceeds, resale registrations and contingent warrant exercise proceeds. There is no single SEC-defined 'actual capital' figure.
actual_capital_phrase.safest_cash_summary: $272.6M gross cash proceeds at closing before transaction expenses, comprising $224.6M private-placement investments and $48.0M released SPAC trust funds. This is separate from 388.91M XRP contributed in kind.

details: RLUSD support spans XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
Coinbase Global Exchange collateral eligibility was described as a future follow-up, not live in the announcement.
SBI VC Trade announced RLUSD availability in Japan as a regulated electronic payment instrument.
This is RLUSD distribution, not an XRP purchase.

details: The announcement describes a study, not a production payment rail with disclosed volume.
Users can choose among XRP, BTC and ETH rewards.
Rewards are not evidence of equivalent spot-market purchases or institutional XRP capital.
SBI VC Trade reports support for USDC, JPYSC and RLUSD and a stablecoin lending service.

The November 2, 2026 JPYSC lending balance exceeded JPY 10B and the JPYSC handling balance exceeded JPY 30B.
does_not_prove: These JPYSC balances are not XRP collateral or XRP settlement volume.

This is evidence of a multi-chain strategy, not an XRP-only strategy.

Coinbase reported approximately $22B average USDC held in its products; this is customer/product balance, not corporate cash or XRP.
A shared service provider does not establish a direct Circle–Ripple partnership.
Ripple names BNY as primary RLUSD reserve custodian; this is distinct from the Circle–BNY relationship.

circle_q3_2026.interpretation: Gross minting and redemptions are not net capital; CPN annualized TPV is not realized XRP settlement volume.

competing_hypotheses.proposition: SBI is building multiple stablecoin and blockchain rails while maintaining direct Ripple relationships; this does not establish exclusive XRP demand.
supporting_evidence: SBI Ripple Asia XRPL remittance study
SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank invested USD 50M in Circle shares, and SBI Holdings/Circle established a Japan USDC joint venture.
SBI VC Trade reported JPYSC lending balances above JPY 10B and handling balances above JPY 30B as of November 2, 2026.
SBI Holdings invested approximately USD 50M in Startale and is developing the separate Strium L1.
disconfirming_evidence: The XRPL study and RLUSD partnership demonstrate real Ripple-linked strategic activity, but no production volume or XRP-specific capital flow is disclosed.
Stablecoin lending/handling balances and Strium development do not demonstrate XRP purchases or XRP settlement.

competing_hypotheses.proposition: Evernorth's XRP holdings combine cash-purchased XRP and in-kind contributions; gross cash proceeds, debt and contingent facilities are distinct.
supporting_evidence: SEC reports $272.6M gross cash at closing before expenses and 388.91M XRP in kind.
$214.0M cash was used to acquire 84.365876M XRP.
ELOC had received no proceeds as of the prospectus.
disconfirming_evidence: Future ELOC draws or use of $30M note proceeds for XRP acquisition may add later cash demand; the filing does not quantify such future purchases.

competing_hypotheses.proposition: The announced Coinbase–Ripple relationship expands RLUSD distribution; Global Exchange collateral eligibility was still future work.
supporting_evidence: RLUSD live on Prime, Exchange and Retail.
Collateral eligibility was described as a future follow-up.
disconfirming_evidence: Future collateral eligibility could create an additional use case if implemented and if XRP or RLUSD eligibility is specified; the announcement does not establish that today.

competing_hypotheses.proposition: Japanese SBIC East/Central/West companies are unrelated to SBI Holdings and to the academic Social Bias Inference Corpus.
supporting_evidence: Three official legal profiles identify separate Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka companies.
Official pages identify the three as sister companies.
disconfirming_evidence: The acronym is visually similar to SBI, but no corporate control or ownership link to SBI Holdings is established.

red_team_objections: Do not add cash subscriptions, XRP purchased with cash and in-kind XRP as if they were three independent capital injections.
The $48M SPAC trust release is gross cash at closing but is not a new XRP purchase.
The $30M convertible notes are debt; the holder can elect cash settlement and the disclosed cash settlement exposure can reach approximately $120M under the conversion cap.
The $9.7M related-party facility was due within five business days after closing; the prospectus does not confirm repayment.
The ELOC had received zero proceeds as of the prospectus date, despite a potential $76.8M gross facility size.
The 73.688M-share resale registration does not itself deliver proceeds to Evernorth.
RLUSD adoption, stablecoin DvP, XRP reward programs and XRPL remittance studies are not proof of XRP spot purchases or live XRP settlement volume.
SBIC is an acronym collision; do not merge regional SBIC companies with SBI Holdings or the Social Bias Inference Corpus.

reasons: Primary filings and issuer announcements are not captured as byte-complete raw receipts in this run.
Corporate announcements do not establish executed XRP market purchases unless the filing explicitly reports them.
The capital taxonomy is not a point-in-time market feature and must be reconciled against subsequent filings before use in forecasts.
SBI VC Trade stablecoin lending/handling balances are issuer-reported service metrics, not XRP flow or collateral data.

forecast.reason: Institutional relationship and capital disclosures are context variables, not a validated directional XRP signal.

next_actions: Monitor subsequent 8-K/10-Q filings for actual ELOC drawdowns, warrant exercises, note conversions and repayment of the Ripple facility.
Reconcile the detailed XRP contribution line items to the 388,910,554 XRP aggregate without double counting.
Track actual XRP acquisitions from the $30M note proceeds separately from stated intended uses.
Track RLUSD circulation and venue-specific collateral eligibility separately from XRP collateral.
Track SBI VC Trade product balances, stablecoin lending and XRPL settlement volume only when absolute issuer/ledger evidence is published.
Retain SBIC East/Central/West identity separately from SBI Holdings and the Social Bias Inference Corpus.
Track SBI VC Trade's JPYSC lending and handling balances separately from USDC and RLUSD; do not treat them as XRP collateral or XRP settlement.
